mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order (order_no, user_id, contact, total_price, status, query_password, pay_method, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{contact}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{queryPassword}, #{payMethod}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mall_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT * FROM mall_order ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
